summary: The only study meeting the rule is an 18-patient RCT in hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 1 at 400 mg/kg/day, positive on its primary outcome (30626650). These labels print 500 to 2000 mg per serving of plain L-serine; one carries cognitive and sleep purposes. Sleep crossovers report subjective improvement, but the abstract gives no dose, no sample size and no primary outcome (25197619). Other human work is a combination with EPA (32520991), a phase I study with historical controls (28527102), children with GRIN variants (41265180, 38380699), or circadian timing measures (36028887, 29070712).

population.description: 18 patients aged 18-70 with symptomatic HSAN1; 16 completed.

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial with open-label extension; 1 year controlled

outcomes.name: CMTNS at 1 year: -1.5 units relative to placebo, 95% CI -2.8 to -0.1, p = 0.03

limitations: Rare genetic disease, not a general neurological population.
Dose is by body weight and far above label amounts in most adults; no conversion made.
Small trial. Funding isn't stated in the abstract.

dose.reported_regimen: L-serine or placebo 30 min before going to bed; amount not in the abstract.

normalization.basis: Assigned daily amount as printed in the source; no conversion.

read_not_used.36028887: 33 students, 3.0 g before bed for 2 weeks, double-blind but the abstract doesn't state randomization. DLMO change differed (p = 0.04); no significant change in sleeping habits; no primary outcome named.
read_not_used.29070712: Mainly a mouse study; the human part reports DLMO phase advance after bright light. Dose and sample not in the abstract as read.
read_not_used.37242260: Open crossover with no placebo arm, 160 subjects across four supplements, L-serine 300 mg/day; abstract cut at the length read.
read_not_used.32520991: Combination of 594 mg L-serine and 149 mg EPA, so not the ingredient alone.
read_not_used.28527102: Phase I in 20 ALS patients at 0.5 to 15 g twice daily, compared with matched historical placebo controls; on clinician_items.
read_not_used.41265180: Double-blind n-of-1 trials in 4 children with GRIN2B variants; dose not in the abstract.
read_not_used.38380699: Non-randomized open-label single-arm trial in children with GRIN variants.
read_not_used.34201370: Tolerance study of graded doses in healthy men, not efficacy; on clinician_items.

stop_or_hold: Dose values can't express 400 mg/kg/day (30626650); it stays in regimen text. This blocks eligibility for that study as drafted unless a clinician rules on the weight-based dose.
